message:
feat(source): recurse through fully applied function-valued constructor children

Preserve dependent function arguments and child indices in real recursor hypothesis applications. Share scoped lowering across ordinary matches and matrices; retain all supplied arguments and annotations. Constrained calls specialize their conditional hypotheses before adding source arguments and equality evidence.

Nineteen source regressions cover generic and indexed children, accessibility folds with a real predecessor step, mixed field arities, partial calls under lambdas, private hypothesis isolation, invalid unused annotations, and resource recovery. Local five-package tests: 1896 top-level passes; scoped Clippy, workspace compilation and formatting pass. Remote gates repeat before non-forced publication. No checker changes, new axioms or dependencies. Related: fln-qb5, fln-kpd.
